name: DOGE VolFavorite, early checkpoints
description: xrp-volfav-early (VolFavorite, checkpoints 480/360/300/240 s before close, monthly refit on own history) moved unchanged to DOGE.
hypothesis: Retail-heavy thin 15-minute markets overprice short-horizon vol (ETH, XRP passed lockbox; BTC efficient). XRP's early-horizon variant beat the full-horizon rule (+2.10c vs +1.33c; lockbox +2.50c) on the stated reason that late buyers are informed. DOGE's unpruned VolFavorite was inconclusive (+0.57c, 3,157 mkts); this tests whether the early-only variant lifts it. Rule fixed in advance, no tuning. Wrong if the pooled full CI <= 0 or <60% months positive.
